title: Western Star hi-tensile custom Aluminium FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar #18
description: Western Star polished hi-tensile aluminium FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar. with extended main channel. Choice of 76mm or 88mm heavy duty 6mm walled diameter pipe. One piece pipes on main cross pipes pass through drilled heavy duty narrow depth uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights extend to the bottom of the main channel. Combination Indicator, daylight running LED lights on outer uprights. The main bar is fitted with 6mm high tensile support gussets. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to suit customer requirements. Provision for lower mud flaps. Flip over aluminium Road Train & Long Vehicle signs.
